name: Tooltip
description: Shows a one-line hint when a control is hovered or focused.
propsSummary: delay: number (default: 500, 0 inside the warm window)

children.description: The element that triggers the tooltip

content.description: Content to display in the tooltip

shortcut.description: A keyboard shortcut shown after the text, such as ⌘K

side.description: Which side to show the tooltip

delay.description: Rest before opening (ms). Defaults to the provider's delay, or 500 with a 300ms warm window after another tip closes

disabled.description: Render the child alone, with no tip

contentProps.description: Props for the tip surface: id, className and data-* attributes

closeOnClick.description: Whether pressing the trigger closes the tip until the pointer leaves

when: Showing text that had to be truncated
One line of help, no more
whenNot: Help longer than a line — use Popover
Anything the user must not miss — use Alert
Content they need to click — use Popover or Menu
Touch-first screens, where there is no hover
guidelines: Never just repeat the visible label
Always leave a non-hover path to the same information
Put a keyboard shortcut in shortcut, not in the text
A disabled control is wrapped automatically so its tip still shows on hover
Wrap a toolbar in Tooltip.Provider to share one rest and warm window
contentProps sets attributes on the tip surface
accessibility: Opens on keyboard focus, not only hover
The open delay stops tooltips flashing while the pointer crosses the screen
Do not put anything critical here — treat it as a hint, not a label

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Appears after a short delay above the trigger.

examples.name: Positions
examples.description: Four sides; it flips if the edge is too close.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="md" align="center" wrap>
  <Tooltip content="Top tooltip" side="top">
    <Button variant="soft">Top</Button>
  </Tooltip>
  <Tooltip content="Bottom tooltip" side="bottom">
    <Button variant="soft">Bottom</Button>
  </Tooltip>
  <Tooltip content="Left tooltip" side="left">
    <Button variant="soft">Left</Button>
  </Tooltip>
  <Tooltip content="Right tooltip" side="right">
    <Button variant="soft">Right</Button>
  </Tooltip>
</Stack>

examples.name: With Shortcut
examples.description: A shortcut follows the text at the regular weight.

examples.name: With Content Props
examples.description: contentProps lands on the popup element itself.
examples.code:
<Tooltip
  content="Styled through contentProps"
  contentProps={{ id: 'custom-tooltip-popup' }}
>
  <Button variant="soft">Custom popup</Button>
</Tooltip>

examples.name: On a disabled control
examples.description: The tip still explains why the control is off.
examples.code:
<Tooltip content="Pick canonical components first">
  <Button disabled>Activate workspace rules</Button>
</Tooltip>

relations.note: Use Popover for interactive or longer content
Use Alert for critical information that must be visible

propsSummary: shortcut: ReactNode - keyboard shortcut after the text
delay: number - rest before opening (default: 500; 0 inside the 300ms warm window)
closeOnClick: boolean - a press quiets the tip (default: true)
contentProps: HTMLAttributes & data-* - tip surface props
Tooltip.Provider delay/closeDelay/timeout - shared rest and warm window (500/0/300)
